t: The Solid Injector allows you to insert existing solid fuel sources (like ingots) into the Fluidizer to convert them to fluid or mix them to create a new fuel.
固体注入器可以让你将已有的固体燃料来源（如锭）注入流化器，将其转换为流体，或将它们混合以制造出新的燃料。
